scope: Corollary 6.3 of the manuscript “Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets” (preprints/Strongly-rational-unitary-vertex-operator-algebras-and-conformal-nets-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 280 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5f09142bda3ec3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be a simple unitary strongly rational VOA, and let M, N, K be unitary grading-restricted finite-length V -modules. Every intertwining operator Φ of type (︁ K M N )︁ is poly- nomially energy-bounded for every homogeneous charge vector and has the strong intertwining property with all observable fields. More precisely, for homogeneous a ∈ M of weight d, write Φ(a, z) = ∑︂ µ Φ(a)[µ]z−µ−d . There are C > 0 and nonnegative integers s, k such that ∥Φ(a)[µ]b∥ ≤ C(1 + |µ|)s ∥(1 + L0)k b∥ (b ∈ N). If a smooth test f is supported in a lifted interval I, the closed off-diagonal smear Φ(a, f) on HN ⊕ HK is affiliated with the commutant of the algebra generated by diag (︁ Y N (v, g), Y K(v, g) )︁ , v ∈ V, supp g ⊂ J, for every interval J disjoint from I.
